verdict.rationale: Codegen's API docs explicitly list triggering agents from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail as a supported use. Its agents can fix bugs and open pull requests, and a 'ban all checks for a PR' endpoint suggests check-linked agents exist. However, the evidence shows this flow only as an API-triggered pattern the team must wire up itself, not as a documented native auto-fix feature for failed CI checks. Missing for 10: a documented native integration that detects failed CI/check runs automatically, a description of how failure logs are diagnosed, an end-to-end walkthrough from failed build to proposed PR, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have failed CI workflows automatically diagnosed and fixed with a proposed pull request

citations.quote: Trigger agents from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail
